answer: What survives to the nebula is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Every claim climbs the inlet of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the ivory re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, capped per identity per epoch, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short.
